description: Add ex_doc (dev only) and a docs: config to mix.exs: name, source_url, source_ref per version, main page, extras with groups_for_extras (Guides, Reference, Evidence?), groups_for_modules (Kernels, Testing, Benchmarking, Bits helpers), before_closing_body_tag only if needed. Decide which repo docs are extras: guides and the language reference yes; ADRs, research, cold tests and verdict as an 'Evidence' group or left out (record the choice). Keep internals out: @moduledoc false modules stay hidden; move lib/examples.ex out of lib/ or hide it. Add mix docs --warnings-as-errors to the ci alias (and check its run time). Done when mix docs builds with no warnings and the sidebar shows the intended structure.

comments.text: Extras: README.md (Guides) and docs/language.md (Reference) only, appended via @guides/@reference lists in mix.exs. ADRs, research, cold tests, verdict, fast-path-report, beam-nifs left out of HexDocs (internal project history, no Evidence group). Three repo-relative links in README/language.md changed to GitHub URLs to silence ex_doc warnings. lib/examples.ex moved to test/support/examples.ex (only tests used it). mix docs --warnings-as-errors added to ci before credo; ~1s warm, ~20s cold.

title: Set up ex_doc and mix docs (config, groups, CI)
